card.name: Final C in SCC cancer abbreviations
card.fires_on: The last C (or CC) of squamous cell carcinoma abbreviations such as OPSCC, HNSCC, mCSCC and ESCC in oncology drug labels. It fires where the abbreviation is completed.

modes.label: Single final C
modes.description: The closing C of an abbreviation like OPSCC, mCSCC or ESCC.
modes.example: applies only to OPSC<<C>>. Testing may be performed at any time

modes.label: Final CC after HNS
modes.description: The closing CC of HNSCC in indication and dosing lists.
